_pass: Every automated check passes on every case: the figures are right, the boundaries hold (the refusal word for word, no advice, no prediction, firms troid hasn't read stay unread), the arithmetic went through a tool where the case names one, troid never says "I", no exclamation marks, and an answer with a number ends with the note. _patterns: Each pattern is a JavaScript regular expression, matched case-insensitively. all: every one must match; none: none may match.
